scope: Independent examination of the frozen confirmation design, runtime/resource measurement and reporting limits. This is not a quality verdict.
reviewer_disclosure: The reviewer authored the task set earlier and is therefore not oracle-naive. This methods review did not reopen oracle answers, inspect model findings or read any quality scores. Runs were projected to an explicit resource/timing/status whitelist before being displayed.
overall_conclusion: The registered comparisons are usable as a bounded, descriptive review-profile experiment. The six-stage A+ is a reasonable purposeful same-agent control, but neither equal caps nor its development cost calibration establish identical actual resources. Runtime wall-clock differences in the two-task scheduling subset are observational repeated-run evidence, not a deterministic pure scheduling speedup or population effect.

registered_design.repeat_reduction: The manifest states 3 to 2 repetitions was decided before confirmation calls to preserve the already authorized global budget. Report this departure; do not describe the result as 6 confirmation tasks or 3 repeats.
registered_design.scheduling_subset: Two task IDs were specified before confirmation outputs; the four paired repeats remain two independent tasks.
registered_design.assignment_order: Fixed and partly rotated, not randomized. For each scheduling task, repeat 1 places parallel before serial, repeat 2 places serial before parallel. Other modes intervene in some pairs. This reduces a single fixed-direction order bias but does not eliminate time/order/cache confounding.

stages: Contracts, state transitions and recovery review
Exact evidence checking and removal of unsupported or duplicate claims
single_plus_assessment.same_agent_evidence: profile_runner replaces single_plus_turns with 6 and supplies five explicit followups; base runner creates one parent thread and sends every turn to that same thread ID. The request filter supplies no native delegation tools in single/single_plus modes. Only the final turn is selected as final output.
single_plus_assessment.purpose: The stages mirror the specialist topics and add verification/consolidation. They provide real opportunities for revision; they are not calls whose sole purpose is to burn tokens.
single_plus_assessment.calibration: The frozen manifest derives six turns from a development mean-cost ratio applied to a four-turn A+ profile. This is a pre-confirmation heuristic, not proof that cost grows linearly or that every task will match B's cost.
limits: Six mandatory passes retain prior answers and may anchor, correct or over-revise them. Independent child contexts and same-thread revision differ by construction.
This tests one registered single-agent revision strategy, not the best achievable single-agent method or every effort setting.
Stage prompts and context organization differ from B, so any A+/B difference is a difference between complete profiles, not an isolated estimate of agent count alone.
Do not retrospectively give individual confirmation cells more turns to equal B's realized cost, or select the best intermediate A+ answer.

resource_fairness.what_is_equal: A+ and both team profiles share the registered total output-token cap, per-request output cap, model/provider, low reasoning effort, packet, and wall-time ceiling. The two team profiles additionally share the same call cap and fixed role messages.
resource_fairness.what_is_not_equal: A+ has 6 permitted model calls versus 24 for B; context sizes, repeated input, cache hits, actual outputs, coordination calls, wall time and dollar estimates are not equal. There is no separate matched per-run input-token or dollar cap. The global cap is a safety budget shared across runs, not equal resource allocation to every cell.
resource_fairness.recommended_label: 开发费用曲线校准、确认前冻结的额外资源单Agent对照；A+/B具有相同总输出上限和时限，实际资源逐题报告。
resource_fairness.forbidden_overclaim: 完全同资源 / 严格等算力 / 完全同费用 / 单Agent已用尽与协作相同的推理资源
required_reporting: Per task and repetition, show registered caps next to actual input, cached input, uncached input, output, total tokens, requests, estimated cost and wall time.
Report A+/B actual resource ratios on the same task/repetition cells; do not infer matching from aggregate means alone.
Report known partial usage, missing-cost counts, truncations and cap exhaustion separately; unknown is not zero and peak reservations are not invoices.
Show both raw token quantities and price-weighted cost. Cache-heavy repeated input can make greater token traffic cheaper; dollar similarity does not establish equal compute.
A/B quality can still have business value at higher cost, but that value judgment must use observed quality plus reported costs and remain separate from an equal-resource causal claim.

shared_budget_order_risk.interpretation: The sum of output ceilings exceeds the shared one-million-output budget, which also includes earlier authorized work. Ceilings are not planned actual consumption; this is not by itself an error. If the global ledger exhausts, later assignments can be censored by fixed order. Preserve every assignment and report started versus not_started plus remaining reservations, rather than analyzing only the affordable tail-free subset.

resource_snapshot_not_final_result.scope: Only resource/timing/status keys were displayed. This mid-batch snapshot illustrates resource non-equality; it must not be used as a final quality or performance conclusion.
resource_snapshot_not_final_result.illustration_only: B had more input and requests while A+ had more output and higher estimated cost in this partial same-cell snapshot. There is no single sense in which one consumed exactly the same resource or universally more resource.

design_strengths: Exact fixed role messages, complete common packet and fork_context=false reduce parent-to-later-child result leakage.
Spawn-message enum and exact-value guard reject added hints or summaries, and each role may be spawned once. The profile verifies role coverage in runtime lifecycle records.
Both conditions use the same registered roles, limits, model and synthesis instruction; scheduling instructions are the intended contrast.
The evaluator retains per-task/repeat time differences and ratios and records whether child schedule evidence conforms.
remaining_confounders: Each condition resamples model reasoning and output. The runners set low effort but do not fix a sampling seed; they do not replay identical token streams.
Model output length and parent lifecycle decisions can change with results and readiness. Serial and parallel may issue different numbers of coordinator requests despite equal caps.

Prompt/history lengths differ naturally: serial parent calls can accumulate earlier child results, while each child is protected from those results. This can change input cost and aggregation behavior.
Provider queueing, concurrency limits, cache warmup and hit ratios, network latency, machine load and fixed/partly rotated order remain uncontrolled.
Only two independent tasks support the scheduling comparison; four repeated pairs do not provide four independent business tasks or robust population estimates.
Buffered SSE introduces validation/forwarding overhead; child active intervals and overlapping HTTP requests establish runtime/request overlap, not simultaneous provider model compute.
serial_parallel_assessment.required_reporting: Report every paired T_serial minus T_parallel and ratio with child overlap, actual requests/output/cached tokens and quality consistency. Also report the two task-level summaries. Describe any benefit as observed runtime wall-clock improvement for this profile and these tasks, not guaranteed pure scheduling speedup. Do not pool serial's two-task subset against parallel's four-task aggregate.
serial_parallel_assessment.live_attestation_boundary: This review inspected code constraints, not real lifecycle files. Before claiming same-division scheduling evidence, use each run's recorded profile coverage and native audit. evaluate.py explicitly leaves same_division_must_be_audited=true, and normalization does not automatically populate independent_contexts_verified or serial_no_result_leakage_verified.

timing_measurement_boundary.required_label: Runtime wall-clock through runtime cleanup, with excluded setup/final-artifact/audit stages disclosed.
timing_measurement_boundary.not_supported: An unqualified task-reception-to-verified-delivery total duration. Do not claim the current timer includes final artifact verification or evaluator work.
timing_measurement_boundary.frozen_run_handling: Do not fabricate retroactive missing timings or change frozen sampling. Report this boundary for the current experiment; instrument a complete outer boundary in a future version if that metric is required.

single_baseline_boundary.tool_access: bounded_request removes all tools for single/single_plus; team modes retain only native lifecycle tools. All modes prohibit filesystem lookup, execution, network research and edits.
single_baseline_boundary.recommended_label: 相同完整冻结资料包上的封闭资料代码评审：A为单次单Agent审查，A+为同thread六阶段复查，B为固定分工原生协作。
single_baseline_boundary.interpretation: A is information-complete relative to the frozen packet and is not intentionally deprived of business evidence supplied to B. It is nevertheless a one-call, no-retrieval, no-test-execution review baseline. This experiment does not replace the proposal's fully capable production single-agent baseline or show an advantage over tool-using repo investigation, patch generation and actual validation.

strengths: All assignments and started attempts have separate denominators; incomplete resource data remains unknown.
Quality eligibility and delivery are distinct; the output states DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY and warns that runs/repeats are not independent tasks.
Within-task/repeat comparisons retain unsuccessful rows and only compute quality deltas when both rows are eligible.
Schedule audit checks real interval validity and records unknown/missing boundaries; it does not equate active children with simultaneous model compute.
reporting_requirements: Pair quality-eligible scores with delivery over all assigned/started runs. Excluding infrastructure failures from quality must not remove them from reliability or cost reporting.
Report four independent quality tasks and two independent timing tasks, with repeats used for stability. Do not present 24 quality runs or four timing pairs as independent samples.
Prefer task-level paired deltas and descriptive ranges; no statistical significance, noninferiority, broad equivalence or guaranteed adoption follows from this small suite.
Apply the separately recorded common-material evidence ceilings symmetrically; do not treat omitted private-only references as an organization advantage or defect.
Any positive result concerns bounded review findings, not correct patches, game delivery, Unity acceptance or complete production-agent readiness.

Preserve exact base/profile hashes from the manifest and current normalizer/evaluator hashes. The confirmation manifest directly pins base/profile runners; the additional measurement-code identities are recorded here and the normalizer records its own hash.
